sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 40 (#39) and Internal Quality Checks row 40, plus rows D30/D44 for gate/floor context
evidence: Design reasoning over the five floor cases on the frozen bytes. Blank page: render gate authenticated_render (tests/gates/render/judge.toml) requires a real Kittle & Rowe chat plus wrong-password rejection and Gwen's sign-in; all_pass + score.py sets reward 0.0 when any gate <= 0.0, and test.sh writes the plain zero when /app/server.js is missing. Static mock / seed-copy facade: constraints gate server_backed_local_application requires Gwen to post 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' in M-11, see it after reload, and Harriet to see it in a separate browser context, so client-only or seed-replay facades fail and zero the reward; every scored prompt also restates the hard-zero browser gate ('static mock, static shell, missing backend, or seeded-looking facade fails this gate ... a first-paint imitation does not pass'). Keyword-stuffed page: the render gate requires nothing private before sign-in and a rejected wrong password, and every functional criterion is binary with action-and-readback legs on JUDGE strings the judge creates itself, so pre-printed text cannot satisfy them; the functional prompt forbids passing on general impression and requires a fresh JUDGE post per criterion. Refuse-everything app: the constraints gate post fails (reward 0); even past the gate, every functional refusal leg is paired with a same-criterion positive control ('Every refusal pairs with a success of the same kind'), and polish refusal_in_place needs a successful right-password sign-in. Thin gate-passing app (sign-in + post + list only): functional floor 0.05 of total weight 44.0 means a 1.5-weight win (0.034) still yields reward 0; reaching the floor needs e.g. signin_and_client_scope (3.0, needs mentions, search, transcript and cross-matter refusal) or sent_once_in_order (2.5, needs replay idempotency, search and transcript) -- real behaviour, not a floor case. Visual likert credit cannot rescue it because score.py zeros reward when floors fail. CDN/off-origin assets are explicitly allowed in all five prompts, consistent with the public network note. Risk=true because no judged weak-app run exists on these bytes: raw-evidence-index scope says reward discrimination/ranking runs for this candidate are absent, and the only measured floor observation is the hosted v2 nop (reward 0.0, graded 0, no_op 1, sha f9ca6b6c...), which test.sh zeroed before any judge ran and which is for previous bytes. The judge actually rejecting a convincing facade/stuffed page is therefore unmeasured.
